releases.source: Published before this workflow by the old automatic deploy; summarised from git history.
notes: Guided first game and a How to play screen
Play friends online by link, or tap Quick match to meet a stranger
If someone drops out of an online game, a computer finishes it for them after 75 seconds
Daily challenge with a shared leaderboard, and the Market League ladder
Achievements, a stronger Hard computer and new pixel art
Smoother on low-end phones; your saved game survives updates
Fixed: after reloading the page or rejoining an online match, the game could stay stuck on "Connecting to room…", especially on slower phones or when the app was in the background
Clearer group play: the online lobby shows how many of the 4 seats are taken and which are still open, and the menus explain that 2 to 4 people can play together, online or by passing one phone
Behind the scenes: updates now reach players only after a preview and an owner's approval, with automatic checks before and after
